sourceEvidence.title: Quality Manager
sourceEvidence.quote:
· Promote compliance with applicable federal, state, and local requirements, company policies, and established safety procedures.
· Perform other related duties as assigned.
**Education and/or Work Experience Requirements:**
· Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Quality, or a related field.
· Three to five years of related quality experience in the automotive manufacturing industry.
· Prior supervisory or management experience required.
· Experience with automotive quality systems and structured problem-solving methods preferred. Working knowledge of IATF 16949 and ISO 9001 standards and their application in automotive manufacturing required.
**Other Requirements/ Qualifications:**
· Excellent verbal, written, interpersonal, and customer service skills.
· Strong leadership, coaching, organization, time management, and decision-making skills.
· Demonstrated analytical ability, attention to detail, and effective root-cause problem solving.
· Ability to collaborate across departments, manage competing priorities, and meet deadlines.
· Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and the ability to learn quality reporting and manufacturing systems.
· Working knowledge of automotive quality tools (such as 5 Why, FMEA, SPC, PPAP, and control plans) preferred. Ability to maintain audit readiness and support continuous improvement of the quality management system.
· Ability to regularly sit, stand, walk, reach, stoop, push, pull, talk, and hear in an office and manufacturing environment.
· Ability to lift and carry up to 25 pounds regularly, consistent with job needs and applicable accommodations.
Work Location: In person
